facts.text: Report holder BINDERHOLZ BAUSYSTEME GmbH; subject is Binderholz CLT BBS, in BBS SYS and BBS XL formats.
Floor and roof components in Type I and II construction; roof and floor decks in Type III (interior floor decks only), IV and V; IRC use needs an engineered design.
Connections between wall panels, roof and floor panels, and supports need complete detailing and design satisfactory to the code official.
Cutting, drilling and notching of floor and roof-deck panels are outside the evaluation.
In-plane shear values in Tables 6 and 7 apply to roof and floor diaphragms, but complete diaphragm designs have not been evaluated.
Evidence listed: ICC-ES AC455, dated October 2022.
